summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 6, 2026, raising full-year 2026 guidance. The company now projects Adjusted EBITDA of $2.7–3.0 billion and Adjusted EBIT of $1.4–1.7 billion, versus prior guidance of $2.0–2.4 billion and $700 million–$1.1 billion issued August 19, 2026, a 30% and 72% midpoint increase respectively. The release cites strong demand and favorable freight rates. Forward-looking language references a pending transaction with Hapag-Lloyd but provides no terms. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, or price per share disclosed, so this is not a special-situation event.
